------------------------------------------------------------
GROSS DESCRIPTION
------------------------------------------------------------

[Example:]
Received one cylindrical segment of nerve tissue measuring ____ cm in length and ____ cm in diameter.  
The external surface is smooth/intact. No gross abnormalities are noted.  
(If tumor involved: Describe mass or adjacent structures.)

------------------------------------------------------------
MICROSCOPIC DESCRIPTION
------------------------------------------------------------

[Example:]
Sections show peripheral nerve tissue composed of myelinated and unmyelinated fibers.  
- [ ] Axonal degeneration  
- [ ] Segmental demyelination  
- [ ] Perineural inflammation  
- [ ] Perineural tumor infiltration  
- [ ] Granulomas / Vasculitis  
Blood vessels appear [normal/congested/inflamed].

------------------------------------------------------------
DIAGNOSIS / CONCLUSION
------------------------------------------------------------

[Examples:]
- Normal histology – No significant pathological change.
- Chronic inflammatory neuropathy – suggest clinical correlation.
- Features consistent with Wallerian degeneration.
- Perineural invasion by malignant epithelial tumor – likely carcinoma.
- Non-specific nerve degeneration – consider further evaluation (EMG/NCS).

------------------------------------------------------------
COMMENTS
------------------------------------------------------------

[Optional:]
- Recommend radiologic correlation if not already performed.
- Further IHC or molecular testing may be needed in cases of tumor involvement.
